title: General tolerances for linear and angular dimensions without individual tolerance (Allgemeintoleranzen)
notes: Title block entry such as 'ISO 2768-mK' = part 1 class m (medium) for lengths and angles, part 2 class K for form and position.
Classes: f fine, m medium, c coarse, v very coarse. A dash means no value is defined for that range.
Applies to every dimension on the drawing that has no tolerance of its own.
Part 2 (H, K, L: straightness, flatness, perpendicularity, symmetry, run-out) is recorded but not tabulated here.

angular_deg.comment: Length is the shorter leg of the angle, in mm. Values in decimal degrees (0.5 = 30').
